quarantined_leads.lead: Spanish Fort Police said Kent Blacklidge, identified by officers as a Homeland Security Investigations special agent, turned himself in to Baldwin County Jail on September 5 and faces first- and second-degree rape, first- and second-degree sodomy, first- and second-degree sexual-abuse, and incest charges; officers said he was placed on administrative leave at the onset of the investigation.
quarantined_leads.source_title: Homeland Security special agent arrested on rape, sodomy charges
quarantined_leads.subject_response: No response from Kent Blacklidge or HSI was reported in the checked coverage. Spanish Fort Police said a press conference was expected on September 8.
quarantined_leads.reason: The current-window report is corroborated by a separate Gray-owned local report carrying the Spanish Fort Police statement, but the available record documents only state criminal charges and an agency employment role. It contains no explicit right-wing, Republican, conservative, Trump-administration, or qualifying affiliated-organizational role for Blacklidge, so the affiliation gate is not met. The charges remain allegations and the subject is presumed innocent; no federal criminal proceeding was identified for an A04 handoff. Retained for follow-up after the announced police briefing and any subject or agency response.
